### Prerequisites

In this text, we present an app that will teach you, step by step, how to perform subtraction using the Yupana. To better understand it, we suggest reading the previous texts, in which the movements on the Yupana were explained:
- **Yupana (Addition)**: We explain the names of the movements defined in the *Yupana Inka Tawa Pukllay* method, developed and published by Dhavit Prem (<htcite0>).
- *Subtracting with the Yupana*: We study the inverse movements of addition and how to perform subtraction on the *Yupana* (<htcite1>).

### Practicing with the *Yupana*

To better understand the *Yupana Inka Tawa Pukllay* method, we will use a Yupana with 4 rows to subtract two numbers. With this configuration, we can represent values up to **4,999**. However, it is possible to add more rows to subtract larger numbers, without limitations.

#### The Yupana in this section

As soon as the page loads, the Yupana is initialized with the first level (units) and with two numbers to be subtracted.

Between the bar containing the buttons "🎲 New Exercise" and "⭐ Next Level" and the button "➡️ Next Step", an instruction will be displayed indicating the movements to be performed at the current stage. Upon correctly completing the stage, a message will appear at the bottom of the Yupana congratulating you.

You should follow the steps until you complete the calculation. To enter each number, click on any cell of the corresponding row in the Yupana. Each click changes the digit of that row from 0 to 9 cyclically.

You may repeat as many exercises as you wish at the same level. To do so, simply click "🎲 New Exercise" after completing a calculation.

If you already feel comfortable with the current level, you can deepen your knowledge by advancing to the next level using the "⭐ Next Level" button.
